messages.subject: Changing the axis after view clade
parts:
I have a tree, and viewclade works on this tree, but I want to change the x-axis to make the branch lengths easier to see. This is likely in the documentation, but I couldn't find it. 



Current code
```
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)

tree <- read.newick(paste("/Volumes/ARLN/CRAB/grandeur/iqtree2/iqtree.treefile", sep = ""))

test <- ggtree(tree, size = 0.25) +
  geom_tiplab(color="black", size=3) +
  theme_tree2()

viewClade(test, 47)  
```

I want to change the axis to go from something like 0.0088 to 0.0092, but something like adding ggplot2::xlim(0, 0.0092) did not work.
